symptom: my Pi 5 reboots a few seconds after I plug a 2A motor driver into the 5V pin. After each reboot the board is fine until I enable the motor again.

gold.diagnosis: The motor driver's inrush/current is pulling the 5V rail down and tripping the polyfuse, resetting the board. This is a hardware fault, not a code bug: motors must be powered from a separate supply, not the Pi 5V pin. STOP coding and rewire the power.
